name: John Cachat
bio: John is a visionary and an expert in developing innovative information technology approaches for organizations and is known for helping People improve Processes with Software. John specializes in strategies to integrate ERP, PLM, MES, and QMS technologies. John received a BSIE degree at the General Motors Institute (GMI) in Flint and an MSIE degree from Texas A & M University. In addition, John is Past Chairman of the local ASQ Chapter and led the ASQ QMD Technical Committee on Quality Information Systems. Current chair of the ASQ QMD Quality 4.0 Technical Team.

history.title: Quality 4.0 Don’t Feel Overwhelmed. Feel Motivated.
